title: SweepConfig
description: Configuration for automatic scheduled transfers from a Moov wallet to an external bank account. Sweeps execute daily based on the configured payment rail.

sweepConfigID.description: Unique identifier for the sweep configuration.

walletID.description: The wallet from which funds will be swept.

paymentMethodID.description: The destination bank account payment method for the sweep.

status.description: Whether the sweep configuration is active.

statementDescriptor.description: Description that appears on bank statements for sweep transfers.

createdOn.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the sweep config was created.

updatedOn.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the sweep config was last updated.
